appliedFix.operation: Absorb the enclosed Binhai fragment into surrounding Huanghua gameplay cell
appliedFix.scope: Actual gameplay geometry, IDs, adjacency, hit testing and presentation; not line suppression

feasibility.currentSupportedAutomaticOperation: Same-country Polygon cell fully enclosed by exactly one hole in exactly one neighboring Polygon; same administrative parent and compatible existing seed lineage. Removes the matching hole without changing other vertices.
feasibility.identification: Resolve clicked coordinate to stable catalog cell ID, inspect its exact polygon and all neighbors; never persist a mutable ordinal as the correction selector.
feasibility.persistence: Explicit separate correction plan pins both input geometries, area cap, target, recipient, reason and evidence. Raw source remains unchanged. Reapply the plan as an offline postprocessing stage after a source rebuild, then independently verify, package and rebase display.
feasibility.sourceRebuildLimitation: A raw-source rebuild does not automatically apply this plan. The correction stage must explicitly be rerun; changed geometry hashes or missing IDs reject the old plan and require review.
feasibility.uiStatus: No click-to-merge editor implemented. Current mechanism is a checked JSON plan plus offline CLI pipeline.
unsupportedCases: Multiple adjacent recipients: user/editor must choose which border should remain; requires a general shared-mesh rebuild.
Different countries or authoritative administrative parents: not supported by this enclosed-cell tool.
New geometry or changed seed lineage: rejected instead of guessing.
Genuine islands, coast cells, or water gaps: no nearest-land automatic merge.
Live game migration: no automatic conversion; use a new game for the new catalog.
suggestedEditorWorkflow: Select the suspect cell on the map and show its stable ID, source and neighbors.
Preview merging it into a selected recipient, including resulting outline and area.
Write a correction entry, validate coverage and adjacency, publish a new catalog, and keep rollback history.
